findings.name: Annual Revenue: typing a decimal amount silently multiplies it (2500.75 is saved as 250,075)
findings.summary: The decimal point is swallowed while typing: 2500.75 becomes 250,075 and is saved and displayed as $250.1k — 100× the amount entered. The same happened with 1500.50 (saved as 150,050) and 1234.567 (saved as 1,234,567); the amount survives a page reload as the wrong value and the Timeline shows the wrong amount too. (on /object/company/315b7bfe-a771-4907-b67d-e68db4f146e7 (company record, Fields panel → Annual Revenue))
findings.expected: A decimal amount 2500.75 is kept as 2,500.75 (or the field refuses decimals with a clear message). The saved value must be the number the person typed.
findings.actual: The decimal point is swallowed while typing: 2500.75 becomes 250,075 and is saved and displayed as $250.1k — 100× the amount entered. The same happened with 1500.50 (saved as 150,050) and 1234.567 (saved as 1,234,567); the amount survives a page reload as the wrong value and the Timeline shows the wrong amount too.
reproSteps: Sign in at /welcome with tim@apple.dev / tim@apple.dev.
Open the company record agent1-testco by its address /object/company/315b7bfe-a771-4907-b67d-e68db4f146e7 (or open any company from /objects/companies).
In the left Fields panel, under Business, click the value cell of the Annual Revenue row — the currency editor opens with a currency select (USD) and an amount input.
Type 2500.75 into the amount input (characters typed one by one).
Watch the input: it shows 250,075 — the decimal point disappears and the digits are read as one whole number.
Press Enter to save; the field shows $250.1k and the Timeline entry reads 'Annual Revenue → $250.1k'.

findings.name: Body field editor on a task record opens as a blank white panel — existing and typed text are invisible
findings.summary: The popover renders as a large empty white rectangle. The editable area is positioned above the viewport (its element sits at y=-20, outside the popover), so the existing body text and anything typed are invisible while editing. The text is saved (it appears in the Body row after Escape) but cannot be seen or edited while the editor is open. (on /object/task/2226cb47-d514-4d17-936c-241f8da11c8a (task record page))
findings.expected: The Body editor popover should show the field's current text and the caret where I type, so the person can read and edit the body.
findings.actual: The popover renders as a large empty white rectangle. The editable area is positioned above the viewport (its element sits at y=-20, outside the popover), so the existing body text and anything typed are invisible while editing. The text is saved (it appears in the Body row after Escape) but cannot be seen or edited while the editor is open.
reproSteps: Go to /objects/tasks and click '+ New Task' to open the record side panel, type the title 'agent11-task-alpha'.
Click 'Open Ctrl+⏎' at the bottom right of the panel to open the task record page.
In the left 'Fields' panel click the 'Body' row (once to focus, a second time to open the editor).
A large white popover appears over the page with no placeholder, no caret and no text.
Type 'agent11 body text line one.' — nothing appears in the white area.
Press Escape: the Body row now shows 'agent11 body text line one.', proving the text was entered.
Click the Body value again twice: the same blank white popover opens and the existing body text is still not shown.

reproSteps: Open /object/company/819ddd59-a50b-4219-bec0-c4cbf38d4945 (the company "agent10-testco") and click its Notes tab.
